video.title: TMJ PO Studio — Product Walkthrough
video.subtitle: From Albern purchase orders to Treasure Mountain invoices, in minutes

scenes.title: Opening
scenes.subtitle: TMJ PO Studio — Purchase orders made simple
scenes.narration: Meet T-M-J P-O Studio. The fastest way to turn Albern purchase orders into professional Treasure Mountain invoices. No typing. No re-entry. Just drop the files, review, and generate.

scenes.title: The Problem
scenes.subtitle: Manual invoice entry takes hours — and invites mistakes
scenes.narration: Every month, Albern sends dozens of purchase orders as P-D-Fs. Copying each one into an invoice by hand means hours of typing, and one wrong digit can cost real money. There had to be a better way.

scenes.title: Import
scenes.subtitle: Drag & drop PDFs, ZIPs or images
scenes.narration: Start by importing your purchase orders. Drag and drop single P-D-Fs, an entire zip archive, or even scanned images. The studio unpacks everything automatically — no setup, no configuration.

scenes.title: Smart Parsing
scenes.subtitle: Every field extracted automatically
scenes.narration: The parsing engine reads each document and extracts every field — the purchase order number, the date, line items, quantities, unit prices, totals, and the cheque reference. It understands the layout the way a person does.

scenes.title: Validation
scenes.subtitle: Built-in arithmetic checks catch mistakes before they cost you
scenes.narration: Every record is cross-checked automatically. Line items must add up to the sub-total. Sub-total plus G-S-T must equal the purchase total. Payments must match. Anything that doesn't reconcile is flagged for review before it ever reaches an invoice.

scenes.title: Review & Edit
scenes.subtitle: Correct anything in seconds
scenes.narration: Everything lands in the review workspace. You can see every extracted value, fix a description, adjust a quantity, or add a line. Totals recompute instantly as you type, and the live preview shows exactly what the final P-D-F will look like.

scenes.title: Live Preview
scenes.subtitle: What you see is exactly what you get
scenes.narration: The preview isn't an approximation. It's the real document — same layout, same fonts, same numbers — rendered by the same engine that produces the final P-D-F.

scenes.title: One-Click Generation
scenes.subtitle: One click turns the whole batch into print-ready PDFs
scenes.narration: When everything checks out, one click generates the entire batch. Every invoice is a print-ready, letter-size P-D-F with Treasure Mountain's own branding — navy headers, clean tables, professional typography.

scenes.title: Your Own Numbering
scenes.subtitle: Purchase orders under your own sequence — independent of Albern
scenes.narration: The studio also issues purchase orders under your own numbering. Your sequence starts wherever you like — zero-zero-zero-zero-zero-two, zero-three — completely independent of Albern's system, with the Albern reference printed alongside.

scenes.title: Choose Where Files Go
scenes.subtitle: Pick any folder on your computer
scenes.narration: Output goes wherever you want. Choose a folder once, and every document lands there, named clearly so nothing gets lost.

scenes.title: Private & Secure
scenes.subtitle: Everything stays on your computer
scenes.narration: And your data never leaves your machine. There's no cloud upload, no account, no subscription. Parsing, rendering, and storage all happen locally. It's your information, on your computer.

scenes.title: Closing
scenes.subtitle: TMJ PO Studio — Try it today
scenes.narration: T-M-J P-O Studio. Import. Review. Generate. Professional invoices in minutes — not hours.
